modalities.evidence: standardized 3T preoperative brain tumor MRI protocol
histopathologically-proven World Health Organization (WHO) grade 2-4 diffuse gliomas
including extent of resection and overall survival

output.population: 501 patients with histopathologically-proven World Health Organization (WHO) grade 2-4 diffuse gliomas
output.summary: Preoperative brain MRI from patients with diffuse glioma, acquired with a standardized 3T protocol including diffusion and arterial spin labeling perfusion, with IDH and MGMT status and basic clinical details.
